title: Kenyan Rye Bread Flatbread
description: A simple recipe to make a delicious Kenyan-inspired flatbread using rye bread.
instructions: 2. Slice the rye bread into thin pieces.
3. Brush the bread pieces with water.
4. Sprinkle salt over the bread pieces if desired.
5. Bake the bread pieces in the oven for 10-12 minutes, or until crispy.
6. Remove the bread pieces from the oven and let them cool.
7. Serve the Kenyan rye bread flatbread warm or at room temperature.
